script.title: Why Germany Has Kept a Fake Lawmaker Since 1979
sentences: A fake politician has served in Germany’s parliament since 1979.
Two lawmakers created Jakob Maria Mierscheid on a restaurant menu.
Today, the official Bundestag website maintains his serious biography and photo.
The German language site lists 615 members instead of the actual 614.
Mierscheid issues press releases, posts on Twitter, and publishes mock economic laws.
In 2013, the parliament president even officially congratulated him on his 80th birthday.
He missed his own birthday reception, but his alleged hometown built him a hiking trail.
Is an invisible lawmaker the ultimate public servant?
script.description: Since 1979, the German Bundestag has officially maintained the biography of Jakob Maria Mierscheid, a completely fictitious lawmaker.

claims_en: A fictitious politician named Jakob Maria Mierscheid has been listed in the German Bundestag since December 11, 1979.
The character was created on a restaurant menu by two SPD lawmakers in 1979.
The official German Bundestag website carries a biography and photograph depicting Mierscheid.
The German language version of the Bundestag site lists 615 current names despite actual membership being 614.
Mierscheid issues press releases, has a Twitter account, and published an article on the Mierscheid Law in 1983.
In 2013, Bundestag President Norbert Lammert officially congratulated Mierscheid on his 80th birthday.
Mierscheid did not show up to a reception in his honour in Morbach, and Morbach opened a 16 km hiking trail dedicated to him in 2013.
